Flat magic attack damage is not added to spells. The chance-to-cast effect is not treated as an active buff; one helmet does not establish resistance caps or full-loadout readiness.
Perfect10% magic modifiers and higher farming rolls are improvements, not minimum usefulness gates. No numeric premium is inferred.

quotes: The Magic Find Abyss Warlock Variant stacks as much +x% Better Chance of Getting Magic Items as possible while maintaining the 125% FCR Breakpoint and a competent amount of damage scaling; better for Elite Sniping and bosses up to Players 3.
Note on this setup you only Consume a Defiler, and do not spawn additional ones. They die too easily in the early game without investment.
While it can continue to farm density, it clears slower than the standard variant.
